# Memba DAO

## Members (7)

One founder with 2 voting points and six equal core developers with 1 point each.

Role changes and member-key recovery require 6 points and at least 4 people after 24 hours, or 5 core developers after 72 hours. Voting closes after 7 days; qualified proposals retain their execution delay.

Fixed governance of market config, reviews, quests, arcade, App Store, escrow, badges, feed, channels and feedback is available. A return proposal only stages the configured successor; separate acceptance is required. DAO state migration and treasury spending are not enabled.
